host_about:
I am a friendly and fun women in my 60's. I am very active and LOVE hosting especially international people,visiting medical professionals and students.
I have hosted with other groups for over 20 years!
I enjoy showing people around town and even weekend trips if available. 
My house is in a great neighborhood close to great shops and restaurants and very close to transportation(2 minutes),medical centers (15 minutes)and down town (20 minutes)
Jamaica Plain is a very diverse,eclectic and "hip" area of Boston yet only 20 minutes on the bus to downtown. 
If you prefer to stay close to home there are running trails , the Jamaica Pond, the Arboretum and some great little restaurants within walking distance. I have a private and landscaped back yard for you to relax in along with a back and front porch.  There is ample on street parking.
I keep a quiet house and am fairly busy so you will have alot of privacy .   
You are welcomed to use the kitchen. Laundry available also. Your room is private with a large window , desk and plenty of room for clothes etc
You will have a great Boston experience, I promise!
I look forward to hearing from you!
Ps. No overnight guests ,no smoking , drugs or excessive alcohol
Thank you!

Sue

host_about:
I am a small-town farming girl who found herself in the big city(s) after college at Iowa State University.  My first real-life work experience was with an exterior landscaping company in downtown Chicago.  I spent 2 1/2 years exploring Chicago and enjoying friends.  My husband and I got married in the summer of 2008 and we found ourselves moving to Cambridge, Massachusetts so he could attend business school.  Our full intention was to head back to Chicago once he finished school but we soon found ourselves living in one of Boston's most sought after neighborhoods, Backbay while he developed an idea into a company.  A decade later, my husband got tired of me overdecorating our home (I have a real passion for it) so we slowly started purchasing homes in areas we adore.

Our “home” in South Boston "Southie", McGregor, Iowa the place we met and both are originally from and Narragansett, RI a place we love to take our 3 boys during the summer and for a weekend getaway.  We hope you enjoy them as much as we do!

host_about: I manage a number of furnished units around Boston and Brookline with my business partner Joseph Morrissey.  I am a Realtor with Unlimited Sotheby's  and do sales/rentals in the greater Boston market.  I also manage a sculpture school/studio with my husband, sculptor Morris Norvin.  Stonybrook Fine Arts, is located in the Boston neighborhood Jamaica Plain across the street from the famous Sam Adams Brewery.  We offer a variety of one day workshops on our calendar including welding, jewelry and metal casting. Let me know what brings you to Boston and what your interests are and I will do my very best to enhance your experience and make your stay in one of America’s most distinctive, charming, and authentic  urban neighborhoods unforgettable. I can most likely send you to at least one place you would never find on your own. I am a former Boston concierge, and local attorney and I hope you take me up on my hospitality advice and don't need any legal advice during your visit to Boston lol--but if you do, your stay with me includes a free legal consultation! 
My guests have access to the very best restaurants, café’s, bakeries, pastry shops and Italian import stores in all of Boston and they are steps from Girasole.  Many Italians have names for their homes to make their sense of arrival and time spent there more enjoyable. Girasole is the Italian word for “Sunflower” but the literal meaning of Girasole in Italian is “turns to the sun.” It is my pleasure as your host to turn you toward what are the brightest, best, and most Italian of experiences that are available in Boston’s Little Italy. Inside Girasole there is a list for you to make your wandering around the neighborhood more purposeful so that you can run into the best life has to offer during your stay.  
Ciao!

host_about:
I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

Hi there!

We are Boris and Susan - a young, professional couple living in Boston. 

I (Boris) is originally from Lithuania and Susan is from China - and we've been living in Boston for the last 6+ years.

I'm an entrepreneur and an avid traveler. My work focuses on startups and the transportation sector. In the past, I've been a part of the first person-to-person carsharing startup that helped people share their cars with neighbors (think Airbnb + Zipcar). After that, I have founded - and currently run - an electric bike company called EVELO that makes it easier for people to get around wherever they live. 

Susan works as a marketing professional at a larger company and is a huge photography buff. Many of the photos you'll see in our apartment are the ones done by her in our travels.

We both love to travel ourselves and try to stay at Airbnb wherever we go. Over the last few years, we've traveled together to Africa, Cuba, Iceland, Eastern and Western Europe, and Asia - as much as possible we love to incorporate travel in our lifestyle.

We wanted to share our apartment with Airbnb guests as a way to pay back the incredibly hospitality and experiences we've encountered ourselves during our travels. We know what it's like to come to a new place for the first time and our goal is to provide you with a wonderful, cozy and unique place to stay and advice and feedback that you would expect from a friend.

We can't wait to meet you and host you in Boston!

host_about:
Hi there!

We are Boris and Susan - a young, professional couple living in Boston. 

I (Boris) is originally from Lithuania and Susan is from China - and we've been living in Boston for the last 6+ years.

I'm an entrepreneur and an avid traveler. My work focuses on startups and the transportation sector. In the past, I've been a part of the first person-to-person carsharing startup that helped people share their cars with neighbors (think Airbnb + Zipcar). After that, I have founded - and currently run - an electric bike company called EVELO that makes it easier for people to get around wherever they live. 

Susan works as a marketing professional at a larger company and is a huge photography buff. Many of the photos you'll see in our apartment are the ones done by her in our travels.

We both love to travel ourselves and try to stay at Airbnb wherever we go. Over the last few years, we've traveled together to Africa, Cuba, Iceland, Eastern and Western Europe, and Asia - as much as possible we love to incorporate travel in our lifestyle.

We wanted to share our apartment with Airbnb guests as a way to pay back the incredibly hospitality and experiences we've encountered ourselves during our travels. We know what it's like to come to a new place for the first time and our goal is to provide you with a wonderful, cozy and unique place to stay and advice and feedback that you would expect from a friend.

We can't wait to meet you and host you in Boston!

host_about:
我叫Anne Wang，來自中國歷史文化名城——西安，大學主修旅遊英語與會計，曾在國內從事翻譯工作。自1995年移居美國後，我從事過外貿進口業務、會計及客戶服務等工作，現已退休。

host_about:
Hi there, 

Thanks for looking up my listing, I hope you like what you see. 

I currently host in Providence, RI. My home is in a diverse and historic neighborhood. 
The home was built in 1910, it is large, welcoming and clean. 
It  has 3 stories, 6 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms & multiple common areas. Plenty of room to socialize if you wish so, or to keep to oneself if preferred. 
Whatever you do, please be kind, clean and considerate. 

I typically spend my week days in Boston and my weekends in Providence. When not in Boston or Providence, I can be found on photo assignments around New England or playing with pups! When not playing with pups, on assignments or hosting, I may be found roaming the the world. My favorite part of the world is South East Asia (I've spent multiple Winters in Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Japan, China, Myanmar, India, The Philippines and Indonesia to name a few ;)). More recent trips have taken me to Guadeloupe, Panama, Colombia and various other Central and South American countries. I grew up in Europe and speak French, Spanish and English and understand, or have notions of, a few other languages. I love discovering new cultures & meeting new people. 

I started hosting in 2016 and I’m loving it and  the chance to meet & host people from all corners of the world and walk of life! 

Your comfort & happiness under my roof (and out of the home) during your visit are very important to me; I always thrive to please my guests and, hopefully, surpass their expectations whenever I can! :) 

I adore pets and occasionally swing by with a furry friend or two. I allow up to two pet guests at a time. Please do not book with me if you have allergies or do not enjoy sharing your home with pets. I may or may not have furry friends during your visit. 

It is important to me that my guests are clean, kind, mature, considerate, respectful and friendly. No party, no loud anything and no smoking at the home please. Music/musicians and fun conversations are always welcome on the other end (but not expected). 

I look forward to hearing from you and hopefully hosting you soon; don't hesitate to reach out or ask anything. :)

host_about:
Hi there!

We are Boris and Susan - a young, professional couple living in Boston. 

I (Boris) is originally from Lithuania and Susan is from China - and we've been living in Boston for the last 6+ years.

I'm an entrepreneur and an avid traveler. My work focuses on startups and the transportation sector. In the past, I've been a part of the first person-to-person carsharing startup that helped people share their cars with neighbors (think Airbnb + Zipcar). After that, I have founded - and currently run - an electric bike company called EVELO that makes it easier for people to get around wherever they live. 

Susan works as a marketing professional at a larger company and is a huge photography buff. Many of the photos you'll see in our apartment are the ones done by her in our travels.

We both love to travel ourselves and try to stay at Airbnb wherever we go. Over the last few years, we've traveled together to Africa, Cuba, Iceland, Eastern and Western Europe, and Asia - as much as possible we love to incorporate travel in our lifestyle.

We wanted to share our apartment with Airbnb guests as a way to pay back the incredibly hospitality and experiences we've encountered ourselves during our travels. We know what it's like to come to a new place for the first time and our goal is to provide you with a wonderful, cozy and unique place to stay and advice and feedback that you would expect from a friend.

We can't wait to meet you and host you in Boston!

We are Boris and Susan - a young, professional couple living in Boston. 

I (Boris) is originally from Lithuania and Susan is from China - and we've been living in Boston for the last 6+ years.

I'm an entrepreneur and an avid traveler. My work focuses on startups and the transportation sector. In the past, I've been a part of the first person-to-person carsharing startup that helped people share their cars with neighbors (think Airbnb + Zipcar). After that, I have founded - and currently run - an electric bike company called EVELO that makes it easier for people to get around wherever they live. 

Susan works as a marketing professional at a larger company and is a huge photography buff. Many of the photos you'll see in our apartment are the ones done by her in our travels.

We both love to travel ourselves and try to stay at Airbnb wherever we go. Over the last few years, we've traveled together to Africa, Cuba, Iceland, Eastern and Western Europe, and Asia - as much as possible we love to incorporate travel in our lifestyle.

We wanted to share our apartment with Airbnb guests as a way to pay back the incredibly hospitality and experiences we've encountered ourselves during our travels. We know what it's like to come to a new place for the first time and our goal is to provide you with a wonderful, cozy and unique place to stay and advice and feedback that you would expect from a friend.

We can't wait to meet you and host you in Boston!

我叫Anne Wang，來自中國歷史文化名城——西安，大學主修旅遊英語與會計，曾在國內從事翻譯工作。自1995年移居美國後，我從事過外貿進口業務、會計及客戶服務等工作，現已退休。

如今，我專注經營Airbnb多年，非常喜愛這個能將語言優勢與熱情好客相結合的平台，為來自世界各地的旅人提供舒適、安心的住宿體驗。

我的家是一座溫馨的花園別墅，擁有一個美麗的庭院、涼亭（gazebo）和戶外燒烤區，是放鬆身心或與親友共享晚餐的理想場所。房源整潔舒適，注重細節，讓人有賓至如歸的感覺。

我熱愛烹飪，尤其擅長製作家鄉陝西的傳統麵食，例如羊肉泡饃、擀麵皮、餃子、湯圓與粽子等。未來也計劃為有興趣的房客開設中餐文化體驗小課堂，一起分享中華美食的魅力與製作技巧。

期待在我的家中與您相遇，讓您的旅程更加溫馨與難忘！

如今，我專注經營Airbnb多年，非常喜愛這個能將語言優勢與熱情好客相結合的平台，為來自世界各地的旅人提供舒適、安心的住宿體驗。

我熱愛烹飪，尤其擅長製作家鄉陝西的傳統麵食，例如羊肉泡饃、擀麵皮、餃子、湯圓與粽子等。未來也計劃為有興趣的房客開設中餐文化體驗小課堂，一起分享中華美食的魅力與製作技巧。

我叫Anne Wang，來自中國歷史文化名城——西安，大學主修旅遊英語與會計，曾在國內從事翻譯工作。自1995年移居美國後，我從事過外貿進口業務、會計及客戶服務等工作，現已退休。

我熱愛烹飪，尤其擅長製作家鄉陝西的傳統麵食，例如羊肉泡饃、擀麵皮、餃子、湯圓與粽子等。未來也計劃為有興趣的房客開設中餐文化體驗小課堂，一起分享中華美食的魅力與製作技巧。

期待在我的家中與您相遇，讓您的旅程更加溫馨與難忘！

host_about:
The Whitney, is a 65-room luxury boutique hotel, opened its doors in June 2019 in Boston’s historic Beacon Hill. The property is revitalizing and expanding an existing hotel to create a new landmark at the corner of Charles Street and Cambridge Street in the treasured neighborhood. Named for Henry Melville Whitney, a prominent Boston industrialist and one-time owner of the site, The Whitney offers guests generous hospitality through sophisticated simplicity and cultured comforts

The Whitney Hotel’s Beacon Hill address embodies the best of the classic brick townhouse style associated with the neighborhood and balances the vibrancy of the city with the serenity of its idyllic location. Beacon Hill is more than a neighborhood – it’s a crossroads. Old world and new school intersect here. As do art and intellect, history and culture. Like nowhere else, Beacon Hill revels in the city’s storied past as it brilliantly scribes its future. One of the finest luxury hotels in Boston, The Whitney celebrates this remarkable exchange, drawing from its unique place to bring a rare essence and irreplaceable spirit to every guest touch-point. Within the hotel, discoveries are enriched with the lure and lore of Beacon Hill – with riffs on long-standing architectural details and nods to the modern makers that made this place – creating a connection to here, so the experience feels freshly-minted, time and again, and guests truly appreciate where they are, in this memorable place.

Depending on the location, you can stay for just a few days, a week, a month or more.

Please contact us to confirm the exact availability of the apartment you are interested in. We’d love to host you (and your family) for your vacation or business trip.

host_about:
Hello fellow AirBNB members! 

I started on Airbnb with "Gorgeous Cape Cod" property in May 2015, listed our renovated "Stunning South End Back Bay Penthouse" in August 2015, and listed our newly renovated "Beautiful Boston Brownstone" in August 2016. We also just launched both Boston units together for larger parties - "Luxury Brownstone Penthouse Duplex"! 

I have been successfully renting the Cape Cod home for over 15 years and was a landlord before we converted to condos here in Boston 10 years prior to that.

I promise you I am extremely accommodating to all of my guests. I make sure everything is perfect on arrival and I am accessible whenever needed. In fact, we received Superhost status every single quarter since we began (we have more than 170 5 star reviews)!

I am recently retired after a 35 year career in advertising, and am now a full time host! I am married to David, my partner in in life, and all things real estate, and we have a wonderful daughter, Adria, who graduated from Northwestern University and is now thriving in NYC.

I am enjoying meeting new and interesting people from around the world through Airbnb and making sure I provide the highest quality experience possible for all of my guests.

Thank you for taking the time to view my listings and hope to hear from you!

Warmest regards

Sue

Welcome to Boston and its historic South End!

Sincerely,
Stephanie & Alex

host_about:
I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

We’ll share all details upon confirmation of your stay.

Hello! We are Airbnb Queen! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!  

When Covid struck our world, we were at a standstill! We had to quickly learn and grow to make sure our health and cleaning standards were in line with those of the CDC. We remain dedicated to providing a happy and healthy stay for our amazing guests!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Most of these stays are for children under going treatment in our amazing Boston Hospitals. We are honored and motivated to helping those in need. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

I have been in Boston for nearly 12 years, originally from Colombia but grew up in Phoenix. 

I am an enthusiastic young professional who loves Boston! I enjoy a glass of wine or beer, cooking, and checking out events in the City! Boston is incredible and I have had the privilege to learn about it and experience it! I love it and I can't wait to share it with you.

I have truly enjoyed meeting guests from all over the world through AirBnB! 

I aim to be a great host by sharing my local favorites, tips, and experiences with you. I am readily available and if you need anything at all, just ask.

I look forward to hosting you!

host_about:
I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

Hello! We are Airbnb Queen! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

I live in Boston and like to do short trips to cities in many countries. I work as a consultant all over the world.
I believe that wasting time is a good thing, we are overscheduled, overinvolved, and overstretched. Traveling allows me to kick back and go to museum just because. Or sit in café, if I am too tired for a museum, or do both.
My favorite city is Barcelona, although Boston great, too, and so is Buxtehude, my home town in Germany. I believe you can find beautiful things in almost all cities, and in the end it is more about whom you travel with and whom you meet.

We’re Blueground, a global proptech company with several thousand move-in-ready apartments in a growing number of major cities around the world. With flexible terms and homes in vibrant, centrally based neighborhoods, you’ll feel at home and free to roam for as long as you want — a month, a year, or longer. 

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with exclusive furnishings, fully equipped kitchens, and incredible amenities – making every day a five-star experience. From day one, you’ll enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, premium linens, and smart home entertainment. Plus, access to pools, gyms, and outdoor spaces in select buildings.

Why stress over your apartment? We provide a hassle-free alternative — a consistent, quality guest experience that starts even before you arrive. Because we let you book our most up-to-date apartment listings online, confirm with a click, pay securely, and check in easily. 

Even better? You can enhance your stay with car rentals, grocery delivery, laundry services, and more through our special partnerships. 

During your stay
Upon arrival, you’ll either be greeted personally by a Blueground team member or given self-check-in instructions. The entire apartment is yours! You’ll enjoy reliable support via email, phone, and our Guest App, where you can request everything from a home cleaning to extra towels. 

We’ll share all details upon confirmation of your stay.

Hello! We are Airbnb Queen! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!  

When Covid struck our world, we were at a standstill! We had to quickly learn and grow to make sure our health and cleaning standards were in line with those of the CDC. We remain dedicated to providing a happy and healthy stay for our amazing guests!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Most of these stays are for children under going treatment in our amazing Boston Hospitals. We are honored and motivated to helping those in need. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

host_about:
Hello! We are Airbnb Queen! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!  

When Covid struck our world, we were at a standstill! We had to quickly learn and grow to make sure our health and cleaning standards were in line with those of the CDC. We remain dedicated to providing a happy and healthy stay for our amazing guests!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Most of these stays are for children under going treatment in our amazing Boston Hospitals. We are honored and motivated to helping those in need. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

We hope we get the chance to host you!

host_about:
I'm originally from Spain but I've been in JP for almost 26 years when work and study brought me to Boston.  I love traveling and exploring different cultures.  I also love being outdoors especially riding my bike around town or walking my very friendly small dog, Henri.  He is hypoallergenic and he does not shed.  He lives on the second floor but if you met him you'd want him to visit you.  Henri is adorable and lovable!  He is like a teddy bear.
I'm a food enthusiast concentrating on natural and organic foods but I'm not a purist so I'm flexible and adjust to different situations where organic is not available.  I, must say my favorite food is a slice of good bread dipped in olive oil (of course from Spain lol).
I can offer a warm and comforting atmosphere, a home away from home.   I'd be glad to help you to get around the city, where to eat, finding bike paths in the city., etc. 

I have hosted with Air BnB since 2016 with an hiatus in 2019.  I have 17+ years of hosting in my victorian house through various universities in Boston.  I have hosted for short and  long periods many medical researchers, medical visitors, visiting professors, high tech, artists, English learners etc from all over the world.  
House is between Green line (MSPCA stop) and Orange Line (Stony Brook).  Ten min walk to Whole Foods.  My  house is 2 miles to Harvard School of Medicine, Longwood Medical area, Northeastern and a bit further but not far the medical campus of Boston University, 10 min T ride from Back Bay where you can find The Arquitectural School and MFA is 2.3 miles away.

host_about:
I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

host_about:
We have been providing vacation rental apartments for over 10 years across the East Coast. We are known for our distinctively furnished apartments in popular locations, and for our attentive service. You’ll find that our rates are quite reasonable. If you're looking for a safe, comfortable place with fabulous amenities and Wi-Fi (we know you need the Wi-Fi!) in the Boston MA area, Washington DC, Miami FL or very close to NYC in Jersey City or Hoboken, we'd love to host you. Many of the buildings where our apartments are located feature amenities such as beautiful lobbies, 24 hour front desk staff, fitness centers, business centers, recreation rooms, indoor or outdoor pools and whirlpools. If you are traveling with children, some buildings offer playgrounds (many buildings are near public playgrounds as well) or indoor playrooms. Depending on the location, you can stay for just a few days, a week, a month or more. 

We offer an assortment of short-term apartments in sizes ranging from a studio to three bedrooms that are fully furnished with all the comforts of home. Our local staff meticulously prepares your apartment before your arrival, and we offer 24 hour assistance for any emergencies after business hours. When you arrive at your apartment, the beds will be made, towels and bath amenities will be stocked in the bathrooms, and the coffee maker will be set up in the kitchen with some sample coffees, sweetener and creamer (teabags too if that is your preference) to start your morning off properly. If you’d like to cook a meal, the kitchen is stocked with dishes, cutlery, glassware and pots and pans. The living room is set up with a TV and cable channels, and the Wi-Fi router password and instructions will be prominently displayed so you can get connected quickly. You can also make local and toll-free phone calls at no charge. 

Please contact us to confirm the exact availability of the apartment you are interested in. We’d love to host you (and your family) for your vacation or business trip.

We’re Blueground, a global proptech company with several thousand move-in-ready apartments in a growing number of major cities around the world. With flexible terms and homes in vibrant, centrally based neighborhoods, you’ll feel at home and free to roam for as long as you want — a month, a year, or longer. 

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with exclusive furnishings, fully equipped kitchens, and incredible amenities – making every day a five-star experience. From day one, you’ll enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, premium linens, and smart home entertainment. Plus, access to pools, gyms, and outdoor spaces in select buildings.

Why stress over your apartment? We provide a hassle-free alternative — a consistent, quality guest experience that starts even before you arrive. Because we let you book our most up-to-date apartment listings online, confirm with a click, pay securely, and check in easily. 

Even better? You can enhance your stay with car rentals, grocery delivery, laundry services, and more through our special partnerships. 

During your stay
Upon arrival, you’ll either be greeted personally by a Blueground team member or given self-check-in instructions. The entire apartment is yours! You’ll enjoy reliable support via email, phone, and our Guest App, where you can request everything from a home cleaning to extra towels. 

We’ll share all details upon confirmation of your stay.

host_about:
I live in Boston and like to do short trips to cities in many countries. I work as a consultant all over the world.
I believe that wasting time is a good thing, we are overscheduled, overinvolved, and overstretched. Traveling allows me to kick back and go to museum just because. Or sit in café, if I am too tired for a museum, or do both.
My favorite city is Barcelona, although Boston great, too, and so is Buxtehude, my home town in Germany. I believe you can find beautiful things in almost all cities, and in the end it is more about whom you travel with and whom you meet. 
My girlfriend and I just started hosting, but already had guests from many parts of the world.

Many wise people have said many wise things. There is a German saying "If you say A, you also have to say B", which is to say that you have to follow through if you have started something. Einstein responded to that: "If you say A, you don't need to say B, you can also see that A was wrong". How about that for humbleness of an atheist. Well, I wasn't there when he said it, but this is what lore has ..
Between my girlfriend and me, we can help you with German, English, French , Chinese, some Spanish and some Japanese. 
We explicitly welcome people from every corner of the world, and everyone who believes in respect and love for all others.

I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

host_about:
I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

Hello! We are BostonStrong! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!  

When Covid struck our world, we were at a standstill! We had to quickly learn and grow to make sure our health and cleaning standards were in line with those of the CDC. We remain dedicated to providing a happy and healthy stay for our amazing guests!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Most of these stays are for children under going treatment in our amazing Boston Hospitals. We are honored and motivated to helping those in need. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

We’re Blueground, a global proptech company with several thousand move-in-ready apartments in a growing number of major cities around the world. With flexible terms and homes in vibrant, centrally based neighborhoods, you’ll feel at home and free to roam for as long as you want — a month, a year, or longer. 

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with exclusive furnishings, fully equipped kitchens, and incredible amenities – making every day a five-star experience. From day one, you’ll enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, premium linens, and smart home entertainment. Plus, access to pools, gyms, and outdoor spaces in select buildings.

Why stress over your apartment? We provide a hassle-free alternative — a consistent, quality guest experience that starts even before you arrive. Because we let you book our most up-to-date apartment listings online, confirm with a click, pay securely, and check in easily. 

Even better? You can enhance your stay with car rentals, grocery delivery, laundry services, and more through our special partnerships. 

During your stay

Hello! Thanks for taking the time to look at our listings.
My name is Michael (my friends call me Misha) I live in Boston MA. I am friendly, outgoing, and love to meet new people. I welcome suggestions and am always looking to make my guest's experiences as enjoyable as possible. If there is anything I can do to improve your stay, just ask! 
I travel a lot and since discovering the Airbnb option I much prefer to stay in the real houses/apartments then in hotels. I think through the Airbnb experience you get to enjoy much more the local atmosphere, getting more unique experience and much better vibe about different mentalities and cities. 
I'm very respectful of other people houses and try to leave as less of a "footprint" as possible. I'm very eager to share our properties with our guests.
I'm a hard, driven and passionate, striving to make the best experience possible for my guests. My team consists of a few different amazing people. Typically our responses to our guests will be coming from either Chen or myself! We are here to help, guide and provide a smooth and peaceful stay for our guests (you)!

If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

Hello! We are Airbnb Queen! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!  

When Covid struck our world, we were at a standstill! We had to quickly learn and grow to make sure our health and cleaning standards were in line with those of the CDC. We remain dedicated to providing a happy and healthy stay for our amazing guests!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Hello! We are BostonStrong! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Most of these stays are for children under going treatment in our amazing Boston Hospitals. We are honored and motivated to helping those in need. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

host_about:
I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

Hello! We are Airbnb Queen! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!  

When Covid struck our world, we were at a standstill! We had to quickly learn and grow to make sure our health and cleaning standards were in line with those of the CDC. We remain dedicated to providing a happy and healthy stay for our amazing guests!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Most of these stays are for children under going treatment in our amazing Boston Hospitals. We are honored and motivated to helping those in need. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

Hello! We are Airbnb Queen! We started hosting a few apartments in 2015 and grew to be a small company with a love for hosting and giving back to our community!  

When Covid struck our world, we were at a standstill! We had to quickly learn and grow to make sure our health and cleaning standards were in line with those of the CDC. We remain dedicated to providing a happy and healthy stay for our amazing guests!

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Most of these stays are for children under going treatment in our amazing Boston Hospitals. We are honored and motivated to helping those in need. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!

I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

We are partnered with a wonderful non-profit that specializes in providing  housing for families in need of a discounted or free place to stay for the duration of their hospital visits. Most of these stays are for children under going treatment in our amazing Boston Hospitals. We are honored and motivated to helping those in need. If you are here for a hospital related visit, please let us know prior to booking! 

We hope we get the chance to host you!
